decisions.reason: Offshore energy remains an uncertain but strategic option close to existing capabilities, so the low cost of keeping it justifies continued waiting.
Crew and corporate travel management is tied to core crewing operations and cheap to maintain despite pandemic-related travel uncertainty.
As a flagship digital portal, it still holds option value for differentiation and is not too costly to keep while uncertainty resolves.
The app supports performance and sustainability goals but remains unproven, so it is kept at moderate cost while its value becomes clearer.
